meta.name: causal-inference
meta.description: Determine cause-and-effect relationships using propensity scoring, instrumental variables, and causal graphs for policy evaluation and treatment effects

copy.tagline: 用因果推断方法评估政策效果与处理效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在观测数据中识别因果关系
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate policy impact and treatment effects using causal inference methods
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify causal relationships from observational data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用倾向评分匹配、工具变量、因果图等方法，分析因果效应，输出处理效应估计、敏感度分析等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求评估政策干预或业务决策的因果影响，或处理观察数据中的混杂变量时触发。

say.text: 请用倾向评分匹配分析这个培训项目对工资的影响。
say.note: Claude 会执行匹配并估计处理效应。

say.text: 使用双重稳健估计计算处理效应。
say.note: Claude 会结合倾向评分和结果模型进行估计。

say.text: 为这个营销活动做异质性处理效应分析。
say.note: Claude 会按用户分组分析效果差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use propensity score matching, instrumental variables, and causal graphs to analyze causal effects, outputting treatment effect estimates and sensitivity analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request evaluation of causal impact of policy interventions or business decisions, or need to handle confounding in observational data.

say_en.text: Use propensity score matching to analyze the impact of this training program on salary.
say_en.note: Claude will perform matching and estimate treatment effect.

say_en.text: Compute treatment effect using doubly robust estimation.
say_en.note: Claude will combine propensity scores and outcome model.

say_en.text: Analyze heterogeneous treatment effects for this marketing campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will examine effect differences across user segments.
